- Initial release of 电子证据四性审查判定器 (evid-four-check) version 1.0.0.
- Zero-dependency tool for compliance checks based on official legal sources, covering TH-LAW-001 domain.
- Provides decision support for the “four characteristics” review of digital evidence, outputting results as JSON IR.
- Reference rules: Supreme People's Court regulations on civil evidence (Articles 14, 93–95) and Online Litigation Rules (Articles 12–18).
- Includes demo and parameterized running modes, with result grading and error codes.
- Intended for decision support only; all conclusions require manual review.
